key_results.interval_note: approximate t interval over five training seeds, df=4, fixed split; not proof of generalization

limitations: Single original synthetic binary-image distribution and fixed train/validation/test split.
Five seeds describe optimization variation conditional on that split, not uncertainty over new datasets.
32-draw negative ELBO is a Monte Carlo estimate, not exact log likelihood.
Warmup hypothesis is not supported; this does not establish that all warmup schedules are ineffective.
Template validity is a transparent proxy, not a complete visual-quality measure.
Only monotonic warmup is implemented; no cyclical schedule or language model replication.
